profile.jobTitle: Software Engineer - Java, Spring Boot, GraphQL, GCP BigQuery, Elasticsearch, Redis
profile.summary:
When I’m not developing complex distributed systems to process data on millions real estate listing, you’ll probably find me slamming my guitar or trying (and failing) to perfect my latte art. I’m a software engineer who believes that both good code and good coffee require patience, practice, and creativity.

I’m a backend software engineer with over nine years of experience, building scalable, high-performance APIs and data-driven systems using Java and Spring Boot. I have worked across frontend and backend for companies of various sizes — from agile startups where I wore many hats to large enterprises where precision and reliability were key.

Over time, I’ve developed a strong focus on API design, data integration, and automation, with hands-on experience in cloud environments (GCP, Kubernetes) and CI/CD using Jenkins. I enjoy taking ownership of projects end to end — from design and implementation to monitoring and optimization — and finding ways to improve both the codebase and the developer experience.

Beyond the code, I’m passionate about learning across disciplines — the “wannabe generalist” mindset — whether that means exploring DevOps, experimenting with AI tools, or simply understanding how different systems fit together.

ACCOMPLISHMENTS
at Cotality:
- Developed Automated Valuation Models (AVM) and MLS RESTful APIs using Java and Spring Boot, enabling faster access to over 2M active U.S. property listings and expanding user query capabilities by 5×.

- Engineered a Property Data GraphQL API that unified real estate data domains (mortgages, insurance, climate risk, FEMA), improving query flexibility and developer efficiency by 50%+.

- Automated Veracode security scans and SonarQube code quality checks through Jenkins CI/CD pipelines, reducing manual security review efforts by 70% and cutting code error rates by 40%.

- Built a Semantic Layer microservice using Python, FastAPI, and Redis to enable intent-driven, natural language–based queries, improving search accuracy across applications by 30%.

at PalPilot:
- Created an online job application portal using JavaScript, React, and PHP, generating 5–10 new applications per month and saving over $2K annually in posting costs.

- Developed a unit conversion desktop app using JavaFX that enabled a 50-person sales team to analyze designs and generate quotes 60% faster.

Whether it’s coding, coffee, or chords, I’m always looking to connect with people who enjoy building and creating. Drop me a line — I promise I only shred my guitar, not my inbox.
📧 elvislee0725@gmail.com

positions.title: Software Engineer - Java, Spring Boot, GraphQL, GCP BigQuery, Elasticsearch, Redis
positions.description:
• Automated code quality analysis and security scanning throughout the development lifecycle utilizing Jenkins CI/CD pipelines integrated with SonarQube and Veracode, reducing error rates by approximately 40%

• Developed RESTful API using Java and Spring Boot to access Elasticsearch Index property value data and expand query parameters for users by 5X

• Engineered Property Data GraphQL API utilizing Java, Spring Boot, and DGS, to create an enhanced unified interface consolidating real estate data domains such as mortgages, insurance, climate risk, and FEMA data, improving query flexibility and developer efficiency by over 50%

• Built Semantic Layer microservice using Python, FastAPI, and Redis, leveraging NLP and semantic parsing to interpret user prompts and map them to graph-based business data relationships, enabling intent-driven query resolution and improving search accuracy across applications by about 30%

• Transformed manual Postman regression tests for 16 APIs into an automated Jenkins job for daily monitoring, eliminating manual test execution and saving roughly 4 - 5 engineer hours per week

• Automated Veracode scans for 20+ apps and library artifacts with Jenkins, integrating Slack alerts to immediately report security findings, reducing manual security reviews by over 70% and improving incident response times

• Applied rigorous unit testing practices using Java and JUnit, achieving 80%+ unit test coverage and implemented integration and Cucumber tests, ensuring robust and maintainable Java applications

• Conducted load and performance testing with JMeter to validate scalability for up to 10,000 concurrent requests and optimized API response times by over 25%, ensuring stable and efficient Java application performance

• Developed Python automation tool to generate GCP BigQuery schemas and Dataflow configurations, automating manual updates to cloud config files across multiple environments, to reduce configuration time by over 80%

positions.title: Software Engineer - JavaScript, React, PHP
positions.description:
• Created job applications portal using JavaScript, React, and PHP, lead to 5 - 10 new applications per month and saving more than $2K+ per year in job posting costs

• Implemented social media functionality on websites using JavaScript and Facebook API providing ability for users to share any post to their own Facebook account and increase traffic to the company website by around 25%

• Developed email notification system to notify when users leave messages or request quotes using JavaScript and SendGrid API, improving sales team response times by over 50%

• Redesigned company website using WordPress, HTML5, CSS3 and ES5/ES6 JavaScript to modernize site to ensure 100% responsive to all monitors and mobile devices

• Engineered unit conversion app using Java and JavaFX GUI toolkit equipping sales team with over 50 staff to calculate and analyze Gerber files for price quotes 60% faster

positions.title: Web Developer Summer Intern - AWS EC2, PHP, JavaScript
positions.description:
• Created an AWS EC2 instance and installed with MySQL database, connecting FileMaker database through ODBC for future data migration

• Built a PHP and JavaScript based online quiz for Quality Control workers to take, saving user profiles and answers in the MySQL database on AWS EC2, and displaying the quiz result
